propositions: Every newly certified plan review must emit exactly one deterministic signed pin for each direct child and each normalized prerequisite, sorted lexicographically by role then canonical ID
Plan material pins must contain role (child or prerequisite), canonical ticket ID, and 16-lowercase-hex material fingerprint from the target's PlanContext, never file dependencies
PlanRelationSnapshot must preload all ticket states store-wide including archived states, scan inbound blocks across that full map, and resolve all references to canonical IDs before deduplication
Every unreadable target, malformed reference, or canonical-ID mismatch must raise PlanRelationSnapshotError with an exact reason enum and emit unsigned INDETERMINATE before any LLM call
All plan-review signing paths (ordinary sign, progressive drift refresh, re-sign) must collect and emit the complete current pin set without conditional branching or configuration reads
tracker_head_sha must verify clean git state using status --porcelain and ls-files -u, then return the 40-lowercase-hex HEAD SHA, mapping all git/IO/path failures to store-read-failure
